description: Figure 2 is a multi-level donut (sunburst-style) chart illustrating a taxonomy for medical ethics, with an inner ring showing four pillar principles and an outer ring subdividing these into 26 category slices. The inner circle contains 4 slices labeled Beneficence (blue), Justice (orange), Autonomy (green), and Non-maleficence (purple), each occupying roughly a quarter of the circle. The outer ring contains 26 narrower slices grouped contiguously by the inner-ring pillar colors (blue categories around Beneficence, orange around Justice, green around Autonomy, and purple around Non-maleficence), with each slice labeled by a category name; the slices appear similar in size overall with small variations, and no explicit percentages are printed. There is no separate legend visible, labels are placed directly on the slices, and no segments appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized beyond the color grouping by pillar.
